record.paper_title: Ultra-Dense Cell-Free Massive MIMO for 6G: Technical Overview and Open Questions
record.original_question: What practical, scalable radio-access-network architecture can support user-centric cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (CF-MMIMO), where many distributed access points (APs) coherently serve users without fixed cell boundaries and each user is served by a dynamically changing AP cluster, especially when those clusters must be controlled across Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) distributed units and fronthaul links as user load and locations change?

evidence.quote: Designing a scalable and practical architecture for CF-MMIMO is a major challenge.
However, the main challenge in user-centric CF-MMIMO is how to control the user-centric clusters.
So the key question is: what is a practical architecture to support user-centric CF-MMIMO?
However, the current O-RAN standard lacks a well-defined framework for the inter-O-DU coordination interface.

artifact.status_search_result: The problem is an active and open research question. Multiple recent works (2023–2024) propose partial architectures for integrating user-centric cell-free massive MIMO into O-RAN, but the inter-O-DU coordination interface is not defined in the current O-RAN standard and is acknowledged as requiring further specification. No accepted, fully scalable architecture meeting all requirements has been established.

status_evidence.title: Cell-free mMIMO Support in the O-RAN Architecture
status_evidence.snippet: Inter-O-DU coordination is critical for enabling the full potential of cell-free massive MIMO... but the Inter-O-DU coordination interface is currently not defined in the O-RAN standard.
status_evidence.claim: The required inter-O-DU coordination interface is not yet standardized.

status_evidence.title: User Centric Cell-Free Massive MIMO in the O-RAN Architecture: Signalling and Algorithm Integration
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates signalling and algorithm integration for user-centric CF-MMIMO in O-RAN.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work proposes partial signaling/algorithm integration but does not resolve the full scalable architecture question.

status_evidence.title: A Decentralized Pilot Assignment Algorithm for Scalable O-RAN Cell-Free Massive MIMO
status_evidence.snippet: Considers scalable cell-free massive MIMO under an O-RAN paradigm with decentralized processing units.
status_evidence.claim: Scalability of CF-MMIMO under O-RAN is being addressed in pieces; full architecture remains under investigation.
